card.name: Digits inside journal DOI numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a DOI prefix (e.g. 10.1038, 10.1136, 10.1126, 10.1093) in a journal citation. It fires on the digit just after the '10.1' or '10.10' part.

modes.label: DOI publisher prefix digit
modes.description: A digit within the publisher code of a DOI in a reference to Nature, BMJ, Science or similar.

modes.label: Other DOI forms
modes.description: A digit in a less common DOI prefix or in a garbled non-Latin text piece.

card.plain: It marks a digit inside the number code of a journal article's DOI link in a reference list.
